name: PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk
summary: PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk provides flexible packaging products for digital printing industry in Indonesia. It offers sachets and 3 side seals, standing pouches, lid cups, and roll stocks. The company engages in the wholesale trade of metals and metal ores. The company was formerly known as PT Solusi Kemasan Digital Tbk and changed its name to PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk in January 2025. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia.
